description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ADODB_Compress_Gzip' responsible for gzip compression and decompression of data, specifically used in ADOdb's session management. It includes configuration options for compression level and minimum data length.

classes.name: ADODB_Compress_Gzip
classes.description: A class providing gzip compression and decompression functionalities with configurable compression level and minimum length thresholds.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the current compression level setting.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the compression level, asserting it is between 0 and 9.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum data length threshold for compression.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Sets the minimum data length threshold for compression, asserting it is non-negative.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes compression level and minimum length if provided.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Compresses data if it exceeds minimum length using gzcompress, with optional compression level.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decompresses data if it is not empty using gzuncompress.
